title: Fraud reports and suspicious banking contact - explained
content: Fraud attempts may use calls, messages or links that impersonate bank staff and create urgency. Avoid interacting with suspicious links, stop sharing information and contact the bank through independently verified details; an apparent caller name is not proof of identity.
